source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Επτά Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The page names none of the seven**, so this folder stands for the company and not for seven men: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί Επτά μάρτυρες ήταν ένας Κόμης και έξι Στρατιώτες οι οποίοι πίστεψαν στον Χριστό, δια του Αγίου Φιλεταίρου και απεβίωσαν ειρηνικά.» The corpus holds no other folder for a company of seven on this day; those it holds — the seven soldiers of 26 January, the seven virgins of Gaza, the seven women of Sebaste, the seven martyrs at Carthage, the seven Maccabee brothers — are other companies on other days. The page calls them Μάρτυρες in its own line and then says they died peacefully, «απεβίωσαν ειρηνικά»; the title is kept because it is the page's, and the contradiction is the page's own and is recorded here. `types` carries `soldier` for the count and the six soldiers. It gives no year, no emperor, no place and no hymn. The one `related` row is Philetairos, through whom it says they believed, drafted in this batch. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
